variants.label: Installed + details
variants.notes: Installed plugins as cards with on/off switch, verified or community badge, update badge. Details panel: update notes, settings, disable, uninstall, what it can do and who can use it. Installed plugin pages appear in the sidebar under Plugins.

variants.label: Marketplace
variants.notes: Browse tab: featured plugin, categories, popular list with install counts. Installing shows a consent dialog listing exactly what the plugin will be able to do.

variants.label: Security overview
variants.notes: Summary of risk (how many run root commands, unsigned ones), plugins × capabilities grid, signature status, and a developer mode to load a plugin from a folder.
